### What shipped
A dependency-light JSON REST API (Node ESM, stdlib `node:http` only — no web framework), backed by an on-disk `node:sqlite` store:

- **`src/server.js`** — HTTP router: `POST /signup`, `POST /login`, `GET /me`, `POST /notes`, `GET /notes`; bearer-token auth on the three protected routes; 400/401/404/409 handling and malformed-JSON guarding; `PORT` env (default 3000, honoring an explicit `0`).
- **`src/store.js`** — SQLite-backed `users`/`sessions`/`notes` schema with per-user note isolation; DB path via `DB_PATH`, default gitignored `data/notes.db`.
- **`src/auth.js`** — salted `scrypt` password hashing (constant-time verify) + opaque random session tokens.
- **`test/api.test.js`** — `node --test` suite (7 tests, all passing) spawning the real server against throwaway DBs, covering every AC including a two-process restart-persistence check and a raw-byte scan confirming no plaintext passwords.
- **`package.json`** — added `npm start`; **`.gitignore`** — DB file + WAL sidecars.

All acceptance criteria (AC-1…AC-8) verified via the test suite, a full manual `curl` happy-path + error-case sweep, `npm run lint`, and `npm run typecheck`.
